walPath,\n       KVEngine* engine,\n       std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt; pool,\n       std::shared_ptr&lt;thread::GenericThreadPool&gt; workers,\n       std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::Executor&gt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"~Part()\";\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return the related kv engine\n   */\n  KVEngine* engine() {\n    return engine_;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Write single key/values to kvstore asynchronously\n   *\n   * @param key Key to put\n   * @param value Value to put\n   * @param cb Callback when has a result\n   */",

        "contents": "bool checkLog(std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&amp; copy,\n              size_t start,\n              size_t end,\n              std::vector&lt;std::string&gt;&amp; msgs) {\n  for (size_t i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {\n    folly::StringPiece msg;\n    if (!copy-&gt;getLogMsg(i, msg) || msgs[i] != msg.toString()) {\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n  return true;\n}\n\nvoid killOneCopy(std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt;&gt;&amp; services,\n                 std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&gt;&amp; copies,\n                 std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&amp; leader,\n                 size_t index) {\n  services[index]-&gt;removePartition(copies[index]);\n  if (leader != nullptr &amp;&amp; index == leader-&gt;index()) {\n    std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; lock(leaderMutex);\n    leader.reset();\n  }\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"copies \" &lt;&lt; index &lt;&lt; \" stop\";\n}\n\nvoid rebootOneCopy(std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt;&gt;&amp; services,\n                   std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&gt;&amp; copies,\n                   std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt; allHosts,\n                   size_t index) {\n  services[index]-&gt;addPartition(copies[index]);\n  copies[index]-&gt;start(getPeers(allHosts, allHosts[index]));\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"copies \" &lt;&lt; index &lt;&lt; \" reboot\";\n}\n\nstd::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;SnapshotManager&gt;&gt; snapshots(\n    const std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt;&gt;&amp; services) {\n  std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;SnapshotManager&gt;&gt; snapshots;\n  for (auto&amp; service : services) {\n    std::shared_ptr&lt;SnapshotManager&gt; snapshot(new test::NebulaSnapshotManager(service.get()));\n    snapshots.emplace_back(std::move(snapshot));\n  }\n  return snapshots;\n}\n\n}  // namespace raftex\n}  // namespace nebula",

        "contents": "        });\n  });\n  return fut;\n}\n\nfolly::Future&lt;raftex::cpp2::SendSnapshotResponse&gt; SnapshotManager::send(\n    GraphSpaceID spaceId,\n    PartitionID partId,\n    TermID termId,\n    LogID committedLogId,\n    TermID committedLogTerm,\n    const HostAddr&amp; localhost,\n    const std::vector&lt;std::string&gt;&amp; data,\n    int64_t totalSize,\n    int64_t totalCount,\n    const HostAddr&amp; addr,\n    bool finished) {\n  VLOG(4) &lt;&lt; \"Send snapshot request to \" &lt;&lt; addr;\n  raftex::cpp2::SendSnapshotRequest req;\n  req.space_ref() = spaceId;\n  req.part_ref() = partId;\n  req.current_term_ref() = termId;\n  req.committed_log_id_ref() = committedLogId;\n  req.committed_log_term_ref() = committedLogTerm;\n  req.leader_addr_ref() = localhost.host;\n  req.leader_port_ref() = localhost.port;\n  req.rows_ref() = data;\n  req.total_size_ref() = totalSize;\n  req.total_count_ref() = totalCount;\n  req.done_ref() = finished;\n  auto* evb = ioThreadPool_-&gt;getEventBase();\n  return folly::via(evb, [this, addr, evb, req = std::move(req)]() mutable {\n    auto client = connManager_.client(addr, evb, false, FLAGS_snapshot_send_timeout_ms);\n    return client-&gt;future_sendSnapshot(req);\n  });\n}\n\n}  // namespace raftex\n}  // namespace nebula",

        "contents": "  std::atomic_bool inElection_{false};\n  // Speed up first election when I don't know who is leader\n  bool isBlindFollower_{true};\n  // Check leader has commit log in this term (accepted by majority is not\n  // enough), leader is not allowed to service until it is true.\n  bool commitInThisTerm_{false};\n\n  // Write-ahead Log\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;wal::FileBasedWal&gt; wal_;\n\n  // IO Thread pool\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt; ioThreadPool_;\n  // Shared worker thread pool\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;thread::GenericThreadPool&gt; bgWorkers_;\n  // Workers pool\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::Executor&gt; executor_;\n\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;SnapshotManager&gt; snapshot_;\n\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;&gt; clientMan_;\n  // Used in snapshot, record the commitLogId and commitLogTerm of the snapshot, as well as\n  // last total count and total size received from request\n  LogID lastSnapshotCommitId_ = 0;\n  TermID lastSnapshotCommitTerm_ = 0;\n  int64_t lastTotalCount_ = 0;\n  int64_t lastTotalSize_ = 0;\n  time::Duration lastSnapshotRecvDur_;\n\n  // Check if disk has enough space before write wal\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;kvstore::DiskManager&gt; diskMan_;\n\n  // Used to bypass the stale command\n  int64_t startTimeMs_ = 0;\n\n  std::atomic&lt;bool&gt; blocking_{false};\n};\n\n}  // namespace raftex\n}  // namespace nebula\n#endif  // RAFTEX_RAFTPART_H_",

        "contents": "bool checkLog(std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&amp; copy,\n              size_t start,\n              size_t end,\n              std::vector&lt;std::string&gt;&amp; msgs) {\n  for (size_t i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {\n    folly::StringPiece msg;\n    if (!copy-&gt;getLogMsg(i, msg) || msgs[i] != msg.toString()) {\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n  return true;\n}\n\nvoid killOneCopy(std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt;&gt;&amp; services,\n                 std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&gt;&amp; copies,\n                 std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&amp; leader,\n                 size_t index) {\n  services[index]-&gt;removePartition(copies[index]);\n  if (leader != nullptr &amp;&amp; index == leader-&gt;index()) {\n    std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; lock(leaderMutex);\n    leader.reset();\n  }\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"copies \" &lt;&lt; index &lt;&lt; \" stop\";\n}\n\nvoid rebootOneCopy(std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt;&gt;&amp; services,\n                   std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&gt;&amp; copies,\n                   std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt; allHosts,\n                   size_t index) {\n  services[index]-&gt;addPartition(copies[index]);\n  copies[index]-&gt;start(getPeers(allHosts, allHosts[index]));\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"copies \" &lt;&lt; index &lt;&lt; \" reboot\";\n}\n\nstd::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;SnapshotManager&gt;&gt; snapshots(\n    const std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt;&gt;&amp; services) {\n  std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;SnapshotManager&gt;&gt; snapshots;\n  for (auto&amp; service : services) {\n    std::shared_ptr&lt;SnapshotManager&gt; snapshot(new test::NebulaSnapshotManager(service.get()));\n    snapshots.emplace_back(std::move(snapshot));\n  }\n  return snapshots;\n}\n\n}  // namespace raftex\n}  // namespace nebula",

        "contents": "HostAddr decodeTransferLeader(const folly::StringPiece&amp; log) {\n  auto raw = log;\n  raw.advance(1);\n  return deserializeHostAddr(raw);\n}\n\nstd::string encodeSnapshotRow(LogID logId, const std::string&amp; row) {\n  std::string rawData;\n  rawData.reserve(sizeof(LogID) + row.size());\n  rawData.append(reinterpret_cast&lt;const char*&gt;(&amp;logId), sizeof(logId));\n  rawData.append(row.data(), row.size());\n  return rawData;\n}\n\nstd::pair&lt;LogID, std::string&gt; decodeSnapshotRow(const std::string&amp; rawData) {\n  LogID id = *reinterpret_cast&lt;const LogID*&gt;(rawData.data());\n  auto str = rawData.substr(sizeof(LogID));\n  return std::make_pair(id, std::move(str));\n}\n\nstd::string encodeAddPeer(const HostAddr&amp; addr) {\n  std::string str;\n  CommandType type = CommandType::ADD_PEER;\n  str.append(reinterpret_cast&lt;const char*&gt;(&amp;type), 1);\n  str.append(serializeHostAddr(addr));\n  return str;\n}\n\nHostAddr decodeAddPeer(const folly::StringPiece&amp; log) {\n  auto rawlog = log;\n  rawlog.advance(1);\n  return deserializeHostAddr(rawlog);\n}\n\nstd::string encodeRemovePeer(const HostAddr&amp; addr) {\n  std::string str;\n  CommandType type = CommandType::REMOVE_PEER;\n  str.append(reinterpret_cast&lt;const char*&gt;(&amp;type), 1);\n  str.append(serializeHostAddr(addr));\n  return str;\n}\n\nHostAddr decodeRemovePeer(const folly::StringPiece&amp; log) {\n  auto rawlog = log;\n  rawlog.advance(1);\n  return deserializeHostAddr(rawlog);\n}\n\nstd::shared_ptr&lt;thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;&gt; getClientMan() {\n  static std::shared_ptr&lt;thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;&gt; clientMan(\n      new thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;(FLAGS_enable_ssl));\n  return clientMan;\n}\n\nTestShard::TestShard(size_t idx,\n                     std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt; svc",

        "contents": "  if (status_ != Status::WAITING_SNAPSHOT) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Begin to receive the snapshot\";\n    // Check leadership\n    nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode err = verifyLeader&lt;cpp2::SendSnapshotRequest&gt;(req);\n    // Set term_ again because it may be modified in verifyLeader\n    resp.current_term_ref() = term_;\n    if (err != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n      // Wrong leadership\n      VLOG(3) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Will not follow the leader\";\n      resp.error_code_ref() = err;\n      return;\n    }\n    reset();\n    status_ = Status::WAITING_SNAPSHOT;\n    lastSnapshotCommitId_ = req.get_committed_log_id();\n    lastSnapshotCommitTerm_ = req.get_committed_log_term();\n    lastTotalCount_ = 0;\n    lastTotalSize_ = 0;\n  } else if (lastSnapshotCommitId_ != req.get_committed_log_id() ||\n             lastSnapshotCommitTerm_ != req.get_committed_log_term()) {\n    // Still waiting for snapshot from another peer, just return error. If the peer doesn't\n    // send any logs during raft_snapshot_timeout, will convert to Status::RUNNING, so we can accept\n    // snapshot again\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_WAITING_SNAPSHOT;\n    return;\n  }\n  if (term_ &gt; req.get_current_term()) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"leader changed, new term \" &lt;&lt; term_\n            &lt;&lt; \" but continue to receive snapshot from old leader \" &lt;&lt; req.get_leader_addr()\n            &lt;&lt; \" of term \" &lt;&lt; req.get_current_term();\n  }\n  lastSnapshotRecvDur_.reset();\n  // TODO(heng): Maybe we should save them into one sst firstly?\n  auto ret = commitSnapshot(\n      req.get_rows(), req.get_committed_log_id(), req.get_committed_log_term(), req.get_done());\n  if (std::get&lt;0&gt;(ret) != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Persist snapshot failed\";\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_PERSIST_SNAPSHOT_FAILED;\n    return;\n  }\n  lastTotalCount_ += std::get&lt;1&gt;(ret);\n  lastTotalSize_ += std::get&lt;2&gt;(ret);\n  if (lastTotalCount_ != req.get_total_count() || lastTotalSize_ != req.get_total_size()) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Bad snapshot, total rows received \" &lt;&lt; lastTotalCount_",

        "contents": "nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode Host::startSendSnapshot() {\n  CHECK(!lock_.try_lock());\n  if (!sendingSnapshot_) {\n    VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Can't find log \" &lt;&lt; lastLogIdSent_ + 1 &lt;&lt; \" in wal, send the snapshot\"\n            &lt;&lt; \", logIdToSend = \" &lt;&lt; logIdToSend_\n            &lt;&lt; \", firstLogId in wal = \" &lt;&lt; part_-&gt;wal()-&gt;firstLogId()\n            &lt;&lt; \", lastLogId in wal = \" &lt;&lt; part_-&gt;wal()-&gt;lastLogId();\n    sendingSnapshot_ = true;\n    stats::StatsManager::addValue(kNumSendSnapshot);\n    part_-&gt;snapshot_-&gt;sendSnapshot(part_, addr_)\n        .thenValue([self = shared_from_this()](auto&amp;&amp; status) {\n          std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; g(self-&gt;lock_);\n          if (status.ok()) {\n            auto commitLogIdAndTerm = status.value();\n            self-&gt;lastLogIdSent_ = commitLogIdAndTerm.first;\n            self-&gt;lastLogTermSent_ = commitLogIdAndTerm.second;\n            self-&gt;followerCommittedLogId_ = commitLogIdAndTerm.first;\n            VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; self-&gt;idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Send snapshot succeeded!\"\n                    &lt;&lt; \" commitLogId = \" &lt;&lt; commitLogIdAndTerm.first\n                    &lt;&lt; \" commitLogTerm = \" &lt;&lt; commitLogIdAndTerm.second;\n          } else {\n            VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; self-&gt;idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Send snapshot failed!\";\n            // TODO(heng): we should tell the follower i am failed.\n          }\n          self-&gt;sendingSnapshot_ = false;\n          self-&gt;noMoreRequestCV_.notify_all();\n        });\n  } else {\n    VLOG_EVERY_N(2, 1000) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"The snapshot req is in queue, please wait for a moment\";\n  }\n  return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_WAITING_SNAPSHOT;\n}\n\nfolly::Future&lt;cpp2::AppendLogResponse&gt; Host::sendAppendLogRequest",

        "contents": " lastTerm};\n}\n\nstd::tuple&lt;nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode, int64_t, int64_t&gt; TestShard::commitSnapshot(\n    const std::vector&lt;std::string&gt;&amp; data,\n    LogID committedLogId,\n    TermID committedLogTerm,\n    bool finished) {\n  folly::RWSpinLock::WriteHolder wh(&amp;lock_);\n  int64_t count = 0;\n  int64_t size = 0;\n  for (auto&amp; row : data) {\n    count++;\n    size += row.size();\n    auto idData = decodeSnapshotRow(row);\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Commit row logId \" &lt;&lt; idData.first &lt;&lt; \", log \" &lt;&lt; idData.second;\n    data_.emplace_back(idData.first, std::move(idData.second));\n  }\n  if (finished) {\n    lastCommittedLogId_ = committedLogId;\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Commit the snapshot committedLogId \" &lt;&lt; committedLogId &lt;&lt; \", term \"\n              &lt;&lt; committedLogTerm;\n  }\n  return {nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED, count, size};\n}\n\nnebula::cpp2::ErrorCode TestShard::cleanup() {\n  folly::RWSpinLock::WriteHolder wh(&amp;lock_);\n  data_.clear();\n  lastCommittedLogId_ = 0;\n  return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED;\n}\n\nsize_t TestShard::getNumLogs() const {\n  return data_.size();\n}\n\nbool TestShard::getLogMsg(size_t index, folly::StringPiece&amp; msg) {\n  folly::RWSpinLock::ReadHolder rh(&amp;lock_);\n  if (index &gt; data_.size()) {\n    return false;\n  }\n  msg = data_[index].second;\n  return true;\n}\n\n}  // namespace test\n}  // namespace raftex\n}  // namespace nebula",

        "contents": "std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftPart&gt; RaftexService::findPart(GraphSpaceID spaceId, PartitionID partId) {\n  folly::RWSpinLock::ReadHolder rh(partsLock_);\n  auto it = parts_.find(std::make_pair(spaceId, partId));\n  if (it == parts_.end()) {\n    // Part not found\n    VLOG(4) &lt;&lt; \"Cannot find the part \" &lt;&lt; partId &lt;&lt; \" in the graph space \" &lt;&lt; spaceId;\n    return std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftPart&gt;();\n  }\n\n  // Otherwise, return the part pointer\n  return it-&gt;second;\n}\n\nvoid RaftexService::getState(cpp2::GetStateResponse&amp; resp, const cpp2::GetStateRequest&amp; req) {\n  auto part = findPart(req.get_space(), req.get_part());\n  if (part != nullptr) {\n    part-&gt;getState(resp);\n  } else {\n    resp.term_ref() = -1;\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_UNKNOWN_PART;\n  }\n}\n\nvoid RaftexService::askForVote(cpp2::AskForVoteResponse&amp; resp, const cpp2::AskForVoteRequest&amp; req) {\n  auto part = findPart(req.get_space(), req.get_part());\n  if (!part) {\n    // Not found\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_UNKNOWN_PART;\n    return;\n  }\n\n  part-&gt;processAskForVoteRequest(req, resp);\n}\n\nvoid RaftexService::appendLog(cpp2::AppendLogResponse&amp; resp, const cpp2::AppendLogRequest&amp; req) {\n  auto part = findPart(req.get_space(), req.get_part());\n  if (!part) {\n    // Not found\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_UNKNOWN_PART;\n    return;\n  }\n\n  part-&gt;processAppendLogRequest(req, resp);\n}\n\nvoid RaftexService::sendSnapshot(cpp2::SendSnapshotResponse&amp; resp,\n                                 const cpp2::SendSnapshotRequest&amp; req) {\n  auto part = findPart(req.get_space(), req.get_part());\n  if (!part) {\n    // Not found\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_UNKNOWN_PART;\n    return;\n  }\n\n  part-&gt;processSendSnapshotRequest(req, resp);\n}\n\nvoid RaftexService::async_eb_heartbeat(",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2018 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\nnamespace cpp nebula.raftex\n\ninclude \"common.thrift\"\n\nenum Role {\n    LEADER      = 1, // the leader\n    FOLLOWER    = 2; // following a leader\n    CANDIDATE   = 3; // Has sent AskForVote request\n    LEARNER     = 4; // same with FOLLOWER, except that it does\n                     // not vote in leader election\n} (cpp.enum_strict)\n\nenum Status {\n    STARTING            = 0; // The part is starting, not ready for service\n    RUNNING             = 1; // The part is running\n    STOPPED             = 2; // The part has been stopped\n    WAITING_SNAPSHOT    = 3; // Waiting for the snapshot.\n} (cpp.enum_strict)\n\n\ntypedef i64 (cpp.type = \"nebula::ClusterID\") ClusterID\ntypedef i32 (cpp.type = \"nebula::GraphSpaceID\") GraphSpaceID\ntypedef i32 (cpp.type = \"nebula::PartitionID\") PartitionID\ntypedef i64 (cpp.type = \"nebula::TermID\") TermID\ntypedef i64 (cpp.type = \"nebula::LogID\") LogID\ntypedef i32 (cpp.type = \"nebula::Port\") Port\n\n\n// A request to ask for vote\nstruct AskForVoteRequest {\n    1: GraphSpaceID space;              // The graph space id\n    2: PartitionID  part;               // The data partition\n    3: string       candidate_addr;     // My Address\n    4: Port         candidate_port;     // My port\n    5: TermID       term;               // Proposed term\n    6: LogID        last_log_id;        // The last received log id\n    7: TermID       last_log_term;      // The term receiving the last log\n    8: bool         is_pre_vote;        // Is pre vote or not\n}\n\n\n// Response message for the vote call\nstruct AskForVoteResponse {\n    1: common.ErrorCode error_code;\n    2: TermID           current_term;\n}\n\n// Log entries being sent to follower, logId is not included, it could be calculated by\n// last_log_id_sent and offset in log_str_list in AppendLogRequest\nstruct RaftLogEntry {\n    1: ClusterID cluster;\n    2: binary    log_str;",

        "contents": ");\n}\n\nfolly::Future&lt;Status&gt; ShowSnapshotsExecutor::execute() {\n  SCOPED_TIMER(&amp;execTime_);\n\n  return qctx()-&gt;getMetaClient()-&gt;listSnapshots().via(runner()).thenValue(\n      [this](StatusOr&lt;std::vector&lt;meta::cpp2::Snapshot&gt;&gt; resp) {\n        if (!resp.ok()) {\n          LOG(WARNING) &lt;&lt; \"Show snapshot fail: \" &lt;&lt; resp.status();\n          return resp.status();\n        }\n\n        auto snapshots = std::move(resp).value();\n        DataSet dataSet({\"Name\", \"Status\", \"Hosts\"});\n\n        for (auto &amp;snapshot : snapshots) {\n          Row row;\n          row.values.emplace_back(*snapshot.name_ref());\n          row.values.emplace_back(apache::thrift::util::enumNameSafe(*snapshot.status_ref()));\n          row.values.emplace_back(*snapshot.hosts_ref());\n          dataSet.rows.emplace_back(std::move(row));\n        }\n        return finish(ResultBuilder()\n                          .value(Value(std::move(dataSet)))\n                          .iter(Iterator::Kind::kDefault)\n                          .build());\n      });\n}\n}  // namespace graph\n}  // namespace nebula",

        "contents": "meta::cpp2::SnapshotStatus MetaKeyUtils::parseSnapshotStatus(folly::StringPiece rawData) {\n  return *reinterpret_cast&lt;const meta::cpp2::SnapshotStatus*&gt;(rawData.data());\n}\n\nstd::string MetaKeyUtils::parseSnapshotHosts(folly::StringPiece rawData) {\n  return rawData\n      .subpiece(sizeof(meta::cpp2::SnapshotStatus),\n                rawData.size() - sizeof(meta::cpp2::SnapshotStatus))\n      .str();\n}\n\nstd::string MetaKeyUtils::parseSnapshotName(folly::StringPiece rawData) {\n  int32_t offset = kSnapshotsTable.size();\n  return rawData.subpiece(offset, rawData.size() - offset).str();\n}\n\nconst std::string&amp; MetaKeyUtils::snapshotPrefix() {\n  return kSnapshotsTable;\n}\n\nstd::string MetaKeyUtils::serializeHostAddr(const HostAddr&amp; host) {\n  std::string ret;\n  ret.reserve(sizeof(size_t) + 15 + sizeof(Port));  // 255.255.255.255\n  size_t len = host.host.size();\n  ret.append(reinterpret_cast&lt;char*&gt;(&amp;len), sizeof(size_t))\n      .append(host.host.data(), len)\n      .append(reinterpret_cast&lt;const char*&gt;(&amp;host.port), sizeof(Port));\n  return ret;\n}\n\nHostAddr MetaKeyUtils::deserializeHostAddr(folly::StringPiece raw) {\n  HostAddr addr;\n  CHECK_GE(raw.size(), sizeof(size_t) + sizeof(Port));  // host may be \"\"\n  size_t offset = 0;\n  size_t len = *reinterpret_cast&lt;const size_t*&gt;(raw.begin() + offset);\n  offset += sizeof(size_t);\n  addr.host = std::string(raw.begin() + offset, len);\n  offset += len;\n  addr.port = *reinterpret_cast&lt;const Port*&gt;(raw.begin() + offset);\n  return addr;\n}\n\nstd::string MetaKeyUtils::genTimestampStr() {\n  char ch[60];\n  std::time_t t = std::time(nullptr);\n  std::strftime(ch, sizeof(ch), \"%Y_%m_%d_%H_%M_%S\", localtime(&amp;t));\n  return ch;\n}\n\nstd::string MetaKeyUtils::idKey() {\n  return kIdKey;\n}\n\nstd::string MetaKeyUtils::balanceTaskKey",

If the peer doesn't\n    // send any logs during raft_snapshot_timeout, will convert to Status::RUNNING, so we can accept\n    // snapshot again\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_WAITING_SNAPSHOT;\n    return;\n  }\n  if (term_ &gt; req.get_current_term()) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"leader changed, new term \" &lt;&lt; term_\n            &lt;&lt; \" but continue to receive snapshot from old leader \" &lt;&lt; req.get_leader_addr()\n            &lt;&lt; \" of term \" &lt;&lt; req.get_current_term();\n  }\n  lastSnapshotRecvDur_.reset();\n  // TODO(heng): Maybe we should save them into one sst firstly?\n  auto ret = commitSnapshot(\n      req.get_rows(), req.get_committed_log_id(), req.get_committed_log_term(), req.get_done());\n  if (std::get&lt;0&gt;(ret) != nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::SUCCEEDED) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Persist snapshot failed\";\n    resp.error_code_ref() = nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_PERSIST_SNAPSHOT_FAILED;\n    return;\n  }\n  lastTotalCount_ += std::get&lt;1&gt;(ret);\n  lastTotalSize_ += std::get&lt;2&gt;(ret);\n  if (lastTotalCount_ != req.get_total_count() || lastTotalSize_ != req.get_total_size()) {\n    VLOG(2) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Bad snapshot, total rows received \" &lt;&lt; lastTotalCount_",

        "contents": "bool checkLog(std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&amp; copy,\n              size_t start,\n              size_t end,\n              std::vector&lt;std::string&gt;&amp; msgs) {\n  for (size_t i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {\n    folly::StringPiece msg;\n    if (!copy-&gt;getLogMsg(i, msg) || msgs[i] != msg.toString()) {\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n  return true;\n}\n\nvoid killOneCopy(std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt;&gt;&amp; services,\n                 std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&gt;&amp; copies,\n                 std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&amp; leader,\n                 size_t index) {\n  services[index]-&gt;removePartition(copies[index]);\n  if (leader != nullptr &amp;&amp; index == leader-&gt;index()) {\n    std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; lock(leaderMutex);\n    leader.reset();\n  }\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"copies \" &lt;&lt; index &lt;&lt; \" stop\";\n}\n\nvoid rebootOneCopy(std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt;&gt;&amp; services,\n                   std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;test::TestShard&gt;&gt;&amp; copies,\n                   std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt; allHosts,\n                   size_t index) {\n  services[index]-&gt;addPartition(copies[index]);\n  copies[index]-&gt;start(getPeers(allHosts, allHosts[index]));\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"copies \" &lt;&lt; index &lt;&lt; \" reboot\";\n}\n\nstd::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;SnapshotManager&gt;&gt; snapshots(\n    const std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt;&gt;&amp; services) {\n  std::vector&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;SnapshotManager&gt;&gt; snapshots;\n  for (auto&amp; service : services) {\n    std::shared_ptr&lt;SnapshotManager&gt; snapshot(new test::NebulaSnapshotManager(service.get()));\n    snapshots.emplace_back(std::move(snapshot));\n  }\n  return snapshots;\n}\n\n}  // namespace raftex\n}  // namespace nebula",

        "contents": "RaftPart::RaftPart(\n    ClusterID clusterId,\n    GraphSpaceID spaceId,\n    PartitionID partId,\n    HostAddr localAddr,\n    const folly::StringPiece walRoot,\n    std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt; ioPool,\n    std::shared_ptr&lt;thread::GenericThreadPool&gt; workers,\n    std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::Executor&gt; executor,\n    std::shared_ptr&lt;SnapshotManager&gt; snapshotMan,\n    std::shared_ptr&lt;thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;&gt; clientMan,\n    std::shared_ptr&lt;kvstore::DiskManager&gt; diskMan)\n    : idStr_{folly::stringPrintf(\n          \"[Port: %d, Space: %d, Part: %d] \", localAddr.port, spaceId, partId)},\n      clusterId_{clusterId},\n      spaceId_{spaceId},\n      partId_{partId},\n      addr_{localAddr},\n      status_{Status::STARTING},\n      role_{Role::FOLLOWER},\n      leader_{\"\", 0},\n      ioThreadPool_{ioPool},\n      bgWorkers_{workers},\n      executor_(executor),\n      snapshot_(snapshotMan),\n      clientMan_(clientMan),\n      diskMan_(diskMan) {\n  FileBasedWalPolicy policy;\n  policy.fileSize = FLAGS_wal_file_size;\n  policy.bufferSize = FLAGS_wal_buffer_size;\n  policy.sync = FLAGS_wal_sync;\n  FileBasedWalInfo info;\n  info.idStr_ = idStr_;\n  info.spaceId_ = spaceId_;\n  info.partId_ = partId_;\n  wal_ = FileBasedWal::getWal(\n      walRoot,\n      std::move(info),\n      std::move(policy),\n      [this](LogID logId, TermID logTermId, ClusterID logClusterId, folly::StringPiece log) {\n        return this-&gt;preProcessLog(logId, logTermId, logClusterId, log);\n      },\n      diskMan);\n  CHECK(!!executor_) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Should not be nullptr\";\n}\n\nRaftPart::~RaftPart() {\n  std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; g(raftLock_);\n\n  // Make sure the partition has stopped\n  CHECK(status_ == Status::STOPPED);\n  VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \" The part has been destroyed...\";\n}\n\nconst char* RaftPart::roleStr(Role role) const",

All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#ifndef RAFTEX_RAFTEXSERVICE_H_\n#define RAFTEX_RAFTEXSERVICE_H_\n\n#include &lt;folly/RWSpinLock.h&gt;\n#include &lt;thrift/lib/cpp2/server/ThriftServer.h&gt;\n\n#include \"common/base/Base.h\"\n#include \"interface/gen-cpp2/RaftexService.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace raftex {\n\nclass RaftPart;\nclass IOThreadPoolObserver;\n\n/**\n * @brief Class to handle raft thrift server, also distribute request to RaftPart.\n * Only heartbeat is processed in io thread, other requests are processed in worker thread\n */\nclass RaftexService : public cpp2::RaftexServiceSvIf {\n public:\n  /**\n   * @brief Create a raft service\n   *\n   * @param ioPool IOThreadPool to use\n   * @param workers Worker thread pool to use\n   * @param port Listen port of thrift server\n   * @return std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt;\n   */\n  static std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt; createService(\n      std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt; ioPool,\n      std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::Executor&gt; workers,\n      uint16_t port = 0);\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Destroy the Raftex Service\n   */\n  virtual ~RaftexService() = default;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return the raft thrift server port\n   */\n  uint32_t getServerPort() const {\n    return serverPort_;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Get the io thread pool\n   *\n   * @return std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt;\n   */\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt; getIOThreadPool() const;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Get the woker thread\n   *\n   * @return std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::Executor&gt;\n   */\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::Executor&gt; getThreadManager();\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Stop all partitions and wait thrift server stops\n   */\n  void stop();\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Handle leader election request in worker thread\n   *\n   * @param resp\n   * @param req\n   */\n  void askForVote(cpp2::AskForVoteResponse&amp; resp, const cpp2::AskForVoteRequest&amp; req) override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Get the raft part state of given partition\n   *\n   * @param resp\n   * @param req\n   */",

        "contents": "nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode Host::startSendSnapshot() {\n  CHECK(!lock_.try_lock());\n  if (!sendingSnapshot_) {\n    VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Can't find log \" &lt;&lt; lastLogIdSent_ + 1 &lt;&lt; \" in wal, send the snapshot\"\n            &lt;&lt; \", logIdToSend = \" &lt;&lt; logIdToSend_\n            &lt;&lt; \", firstLogId in wal = \" &lt;&lt; part_-&gt;wal()-&gt;firstLogId()\n            &lt;&lt; \", lastLogId in wal = \" &lt;&lt; part_-&gt;wal()-&gt;lastLogId();\n    sendingSnapshot_ = true;\n    stats::StatsManager::addValue(kNumSendSnapshot);\n    part_-&gt;snapshot_-&gt;sendSnapshot(part_, addr_)\n        .thenValue([self = shared_from_this()](auto&amp;&amp; status) {\n          std::lock_guard&lt;std::mutex&gt; g(self-&gt;lock_);\n          if (status.ok()) {\n            auto commitLogIdAndTerm = status.value();\n            self-&gt;lastLogIdSent_ = commitLogIdAndTerm.first;\n            self-&gt;lastLogTermSent_ = commitLogIdAndTerm.second;\n            self-&gt;followerCommittedLogId_ = commitLogIdAndTerm.first;\n            VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; self-&gt;idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Send snapshot succeeded!\"\n                    &lt;&lt; \" commitLogId = \" &lt;&lt; commitLogIdAndTerm.first\n                    &lt;&lt; \" commitLogTerm = \" &lt;&lt; commitLogIdAndTerm.second;\n          } else {\n            VLOG(1) &lt;&lt; self-&gt;idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"Send snapshot failed!\";\n            // TODO(heng): we should tell the follower i am failed.\n          }\n          self-&gt;sendingSnapshot_ = false;\n          self-&gt;noMoreRequestCV_.notify_all();\n        });\n  } else {\n    VLOG_EVERY_N(2, 1000) &lt;&lt; idStr_ &lt;&lt; \"The snapshot req is in queue, please wait for a moment\";\n  }\n  return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode::E_RAFT_WAITING_SNAPSHOT;\n}\n\nfolly::Future&lt;cpp2::AppendLogResponse&gt; Host::sendAppendLogRequest",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2018 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#include \"kvstore/raftex/RaftexService.h\"\n\n#include &lt;folly/ScopeGuard.h&gt;\n\n#include \"common/base/Base.h\"\n#include \"common/base/ErrorOr.h\"\n#include \"common/ssl/SSLConfig.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/raftex/RaftPart.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace raftex {\n\n/*******************************************************\n *\n * Implementation of RaftexService\n *\n ******************************************************/\nstd::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt; RaftexService::createService(\n    std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt; ioPool,\n    std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::Executor&gt; workers,\n    uint16_t port) {\n  try {\n    auto svc = std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt;(new RaftexService());\n    auto server = std::make_unique&lt;apache::thrift::ThriftServer&gt;();\n    server-&gt;setPort(port);\n    server-&gt;setIdleTimeout(std::chrono::seconds(0));\n    if (ioPool != nullptr) {\n      server-&gt;setIOThreadPool(ioPool);\n    }\n    if (workers != nullptr) {\n      server-&gt;setThreadManager(\n          std::dynamic_pointer_cast&lt;apache::thrift::concurrency::ThreadManager&gt;(workers));\n    }\n    if (FLAGS_enable_ssl) {\n      server-&gt;setSSLConfig(nebula::sslContextConfig());\n    }\n    server-&gt;setInterface(svc);\n    server-&gt;setup();\n    svc-&gt;server_ = std::move(server);\n    svc-&gt;serverPort_ = svc-&gt;server_-&gt;getAddress().getPort();\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; nullptr : copyState(rhs.state_.get()));\n  }\n\n  Status &amp;operator=(const Status &amp;rhs) {\n    // &#96;state_ == rhs.state_' means either &#96;this == &amp;rhs',\n    // or both &#96;*this' and &#96;rhs' are OK\n    if (state_ != rhs.state_) {\n      state_ = rhs.state_ == nullptr ? nullptr : copyState(rhs.state_.get());\n    }\n    return *this;\n  }\n\n  Status(Status &amp;&amp;rhs) noexcept {\n    state_ = std::move(rhs.state_);\n  }\n\n  Status &amp;operator=(Status &amp;&amp;rhs) noexcept {\n    // &#96;state_ == rhs.state_' means either &#96;this == &amp;rhs',\n    // or both &#96;*this' and &#96;rhs' are OK\n    if (state_ != rhs.state_) {\n      state_ = std::move(rhs.state_);\n    }\n    return *this;\n  }\n\n  static Status from(const Status &amp;s) {\n    return s;\n  }\n\n  template &lt;typename T&gt;\n  static Status from(StatusOr&lt;T&gt; &amp;&amp;s) {\n    return std::move(s).status();\n  }\n\n  template &lt;typename T&gt;\n  static Status from(const StatusOr&lt;T&gt; &amp;s) {\n    return s.status();\n  }\n\n  bool operator==(const Status &amp;rhs) const {\n    // &#96;state_ == rhs.state_' means either &#96;this == &amp;rhs',\n    // or both &#96;*this' and &#96;rhs' are OK\n    if (state_ == rhs.state_) {\n      return true;\n    }\n    return code() == rhs.code();\n  }\n\n  bool operator!=(const Status &amp;rhs) const {\n    return !(*this == rhs);\n  }\n\n  bool ok() const {\n    return state_ == nullptr;\n  }\n\n  static Status OK() {\n    return Status();\n  }\n\n#define STATUS_GENERATOR(ERROR)                                                     \\\n  ",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2018 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#ifndef COMMON_BASE_EITHEROR_H_\n#define COMMON_BASE_EITHEROR_H_\n\n#include &lt;type_traits&gt;\n\n#include \"common/base/Base.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\n\nusing LeftType = std::true_type;\nusing RightType = std::false_type;\n\nenum class State : int16_t {\n  VOID = 0,\n  LEFT_TYPE = 1,\n  RIGHT_TYPE = 2,\n};\n\nstatic constexpr LeftType* kConstructLeft = nullptr;\nstatic constexpr RightType* kConstructRight = nullptr;\n\n/**\n * EitherOr&lt;&gt; is a type to hold a value of either LEFT type or RIGHT type.\n * The only constrain is the LEFT type cannot be same as the RIGHT type\n *\n * vs. boost::variant&lt;&gt;: Variant is an old design which tries to solve the\n * problem that only POD can be allowed in &#96;union&#96;\n * (https://www.boost.org/doc/libs/1_69_0/doc/html/variant.html#variant.abstract).\n * The problem boost:::variant tries to solve does not exist any more since\n * C++11 (https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/language/union). EitherOr is\n * designed based on the new &#96;union&#96; in C++11, so it means they are more\n * efficient\n *\n * vs. StatusOr&lt;&gt;: EitherOr is a more generic form of StatusOr. EitherOr\n * supports any two types, as long as the two types are different. StatusOr\n * supports Status and another type. So StatusOr is a special case of EitherOr.\n * Later we would rewrite StatusOr based on EitherOr\n *\n * EitherOr&lt;&gt; provides multiple constructors. Besides the default constructor\n * and copy constructors, EitherOr&lt;&gt; will use the parameters to decide which\n * type should be instantiated. If the LEFT and RIGHT types are similar enough\n * and EitherOr&lt;&gt; cannot decide which type to instantiate, we need to use the\n * constructors with the type Tag.         "contents": "  T value() &amp;&amp; {\n    DCHECK(ok());\n    auto value = std::move(variant_.value_);\n    resetValue();\n    return value;\n  }\n\n private:\n  bool hasValue() const {\n    return state_ == kValue;\n  }\n\n  bool hasStatus() const {\n    return state_ == kStatus;\n  }\n\n  bool isVoid() const {\n    return state_ == kVoid;\n  }\n\n  void destructValue() {\n    variant_.value_.~T();\n  }\n\n  void destructStatus() {\n    variant_.status_.~Status();\n  }\n\n  void resetValue() {\n    destructValue();\n    state_ = kVoid;\n  }\n\n  void resetStatus() {\n    destructStatus();\n    state_ = kVoid;\n  }\n\n  void destruct() {\n    if (isVoid()) {\n      return;\n    }\n    if (hasValue()) {\n      destructValue();\n    } else {\n      destructStatus();\n    }\n  }\n\n  void reset() {\n    destruct();\n    state_ = kVoid;\n  }\n\n private:\n  // Variant type to hold a &#96;Status', or a &#96;T', or nothing\n  union Variant {\n    Variant() {}\n    Variant(const Status &amp;status) : status_(status) {}\n    Variant(Status &amp;&amp;status) : status_(std::move(status)) {}\n    template &lt;typename U, typename = std::enable_if_t&lt;is_initializable_v&lt;U&gt;&gt;&gt;\n    Variant(U &amp;&amp;value) : value_(std::forward&lt;U&gt;(value)) {}\n    ~Variant() {}\n\n    Status status_;\n    T value_;\n  };\n\n  static constexpr uint8_t kVoid = 0;\n  static constexpr uint8_t kStatus = 1;\n  static constexpr uint8_t kValue = 2;\n\n  Variant variant_;\n  uint8_t state_;\n};\n\nnamespace internal {\ntemplate &lt;typename T&gt;\nstruct StatusOrValueType {\n  using type = T;\n};\n\ntemplate &lt;typename T&gt;\nstruct StatusOrValueType&lt;StatusOr&lt;T&gt;&gt; {\n  using type = std::remove_cv_t&lt;std::remove_reference_t&lt;T&gt;&gt;;\n};\n}  // namespace internal\n\ntemplate &lt;typename T&gt;\nusing status_or_value_t = typename internal::StatusOrValueType&lt;T&gt;::type;\n\n}  // namespace nebula\n\n#endif  // COMMON_BASE_STATUSOR_H_",

        },
        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2018 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#ifndef COMMON_BASE_ERROROR_H_\n#define COMMON_BASE_ERROROR_H_\n\n#include \"common/base/Base.h\"\n#include \"common/base/EitherOr.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\n\n/**\n * ErrorOr&lt;&gt; is a convenient type to allow a method to return either an error\n * code or a user defined result\n *\n * vs. StatusOr&lt;&gt;: ErrorOr&lt;&gt; is an alias of EitherOr with a few accessory\n * methods. The left type of the ErrorOr has to be an integral type or enum,\n * while the left type of StatusOr&lt;&gt; is a Status, which is a more complicate\n * object. This is pretty much the only difference between ErrorOr&lt;&gt; and\n * StatusOr&lt;&gt;\n *\n * So in the scenario that the caller only cares about the error code (or result\n * code), ErrorOr&lt;&gt; would be more suitable. If the caller also needs an error\n * message along with the error code from the callee, then StatusOr&lt;&gt; should be\n * used\n */\ntemplate &lt;typename ErrorCode,\n          typename ResultType,\n          typename = std::enable_if_t&lt;std::is_integral&lt;ErrorCode&gt;::value ||\n                                      std::is_enum&lt;ErrorCode&gt;::value&gt;&gt;\nusing ErrorOr = EitherOr&lt;ErrorCode, ResultType&gt;;\n\n/***********************************************\n *\n * Accessary methods\n *\n **********************************************/\n// We treat void ErrorOr objects as succeeded\ntemplate &lt;typename E, typename R&gt;\nbool ok(const ErrorOr&lt;E, R&gt;&amp; err) {\n  return !err.isLeftType();\n}\n\ntemplate &lt;typename E, typename R&gt;\nE error(const ErrorOr&lt;E, R&gt;&amp; err) {\n  return err.left();\n}\n\ntemplate &lt;typename E, typename R&gt;\nbool hasValue(const ErrorOr&lt;E, R&gt;&amp; err) {\n  return err.isRightType();\n}\n\ntemplate &lt;typename E, typename R&gt;\nR&amp; value(ErrorOr&lt;E, R&gt;&amp; err) {\n  return err.right();\n}\n\ntemplate &lt;typename E, typename R&gt;\nconst R&amp; value(const ErrorOr&lt;E, R&gt;&amp; err) {\n  return err.right();\n}\n\ntemplate &lt;typename E, typename R&gt;\nR value(ErrorOr&lt;E, R&gt;&amp;&amp; err) {\n  return std::move(err).right();\n}\n\n}  // namespace nebula\n#endif  // COMMON_BASE_ERROROR_H_",

        "contents": "  // Assert that &#96;T' must not be of type &#96;StatusOr'\n  static_assert(!is_status_or_v&lt;T&gt;, \"&#96;T' must not be of type &#96;StatusOr'\");\n\n  // &#96;StatusOr&lt;T&gt;' contains neither a Status nor a value\n  // in the default-constructed case.\n  // From the semantics aspect, it must have been associated with\n  // a Status or value eventually before being used.\n  StatusOr() {\n    state_ = kVoid;\n  }\n\n  // Destruct the &#96;Status' or value if it's holding one.\n  ~StatusOr() {\n    destruct();\n  }\n\n  // Copy/move construct from &#96;Status'\n  // Not explicit to allow construct from a &#96;Status', e.g. in the &#96;return'\n  // statement\n  template &lt;typename U&gt;\n  StatusOr(U &amp;&amp;status, std::enable_if_t&lt;is_status_v&lt;U&gt;&gt; * = nullptr)  // NOLINT\n      : variant_(std::forward&lt;U&gt;(status)) {\n    state_ = kStatus;\n  }\n\n  // Copy/move construct with a value of any compatible type\n  // Not explicit to allow construct from a value, e.g. in the &#96;return'\n  // statement\n  template &lt;typename U, typename = std::enable_if_t&lt;is_initializable_v&lt;U&gt;&gt;&gt;\n  StatusOr(U &amp;&amp;value)  // NOLINT\n      : variant_(std::forward&lt;U&gt;(value)) {\n    state_ = kValue;\n  }\n\n  StatusOr(T &amp;&amp;value)  // NOLINT\n      : variant_(std::move(value)) {\n    state_ = kValue;\n  }\n\n  // Copy constructor\n  StatusOr(const StatusOr &amp;rhs) : state_(rhs.state_) {\n    if (hasValue()) {\n      new (&amp;variant_) Variant(rhs.variant_.value_);\n    } else if (hasStatus()) {\n      new (&amp;variant_) Variant(rhs.variant_.status_);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Copy construct from a lvalue of &#96;StatusOr&lt;U&gt;'\n  template &lt;typename U, typename = std::enable_if_t&lt;is_initializable_v&lt;U&gt;&gt;&gt;\n  StatusOr(const StatusOr&lt;U&gt;         "contents": " noexcept {\n    reset();\n    if (rhs.hasValue()) {\n      new (&amp;variant_) Variant(std::move(rhs.variant_.value_));\n      rhs.resetValue();\n      state_ = kValue;\n    } else if (rhs.hasStatus()) {\n      new (&amp;variant_) Variant(std::move(rhs.variant_.status_));\n      rhs.resetStatus();\n      state_ = kStatus;\n    } else {\n      // do nothing on void, since it's already reset\n    }\n    return *this;\n  }\n\n  // Move assignment operator from a rvalue of any compatible type with &#96;T'\n  template &lt;typename U, typename = std::enable_if_t&lt;is_initializable_v&lt;U&gt;&gt;&gt;\n  StatusOr &amp;operator=(U &amp;&amp;value) noexcept {\n    destruct();\n    new (&amp;variant_) Variant(std::forward&lt;U&gt;(value));\n    state_ = kValue;\n    return *this;\n  }\n\n  // Copy assign from a lvalue of &#96;Status'\n  StatusOr &amp;operator=(const Status &amp;status) {\n    destruct();\n    new (&amp;variant_) Variant(status);\n    state_ = kStatus;\n    return *this;\n  }\n\n  // Move assign from a rvalue of &#96;Status'\n  StatusOr &amp;operator=(Status &amp;&amp;status) noexcept {\n    destruct();\n    new (&amp;variant_) Variant(std::move(status));\n    state_ = kStatus;\n    return *this;\n  }\n\n  // Tell if &#96;*this' contains a value\n  bool ok() const {\n    return hasValue();\n  }\n\n  // Type conversion operator, i.e. alias of &#96;ok()'\n  operator bool() const {\n    return ok();\n  }\n\n  // Return the associated &#96;Status' if and only if it has one,\n  //\n  Status status() const &amp; {\n    CHECK(hasStatus());\n    return variant_.status_;\n  }\n\n  Status status() &amp;&amp; {\n    CHECK(hasStatus());\n    auto status = std::move(variant_.status_);\n    resetStatus();\n    return status;\n  }\n\n  // Return the non-const lvalue reference to the associated value\n  // &#96;ok()' is DCHECK'd\n  T &amp;value() &amp; {\n    DCHECK(ok());\n    return variant_.value_;\n  }\n\n  // Return the const lvalue reference to the associated value\n  const T &amp;value() const &amp; {\n    DCHECK(ok());\n    return variant_.value_;\n  }\n\n  // Move the associated value out.\n  // &#96;*this' must be a rvalue\n  T value() &amp;&amp;         "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2018 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#include &lt;gtest/gtest.h&gt;\n\n#include \"common/base/Base.h\"\n#include \"common/base/StatusOr.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\n\nTEST(StatusOr, ConstructFromDefault) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result;\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, ConstructFromStatus) {\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result(Status::OK());\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_TRUE(result.status().ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"OK\", result.status().toString());\n  }\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result(Status::Error(\"SomeError\"));\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.status().ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeError\", result.status().toString());\n  }\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, ConstructFromValue) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result(\"SomeValue\");\n  ASSERT_TRUE(result.ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", result.value());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, ReturnFromStatus) {\n  {\n    auto foo = []() -&gt; StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; { return Status::Error(\"SomeError\"); };\n\n    auto result = foo();\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.status().ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeError\", result.status().toString());\n  }\n  {\n    auto foo = []() -&gt; StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; {\n      auto status = Status::Error(\"SomeError\");\n      return status;\n    };\n\n    auto result = foo();\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.status().ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeError\", result.status().toString());\n  }\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, ReturnFromValue) {\n  auto foo = []() -&gt; StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; { return \"SomeValue\"; };\n  auto result = foo();\n  ASSERT_TRUE(result.ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", result.value());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, ReturnFromMoveOnlyValue)",

        "contents": "TEST(StatusOr, AssignFromValue) {\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result;\n    result = \"SomeValue\";\n    ASSERT_TRUE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", result.value());\n\n    result = \"SomeOtherValue\";\n    ASSERT_TRUE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeOtherValue\", result.value());\n  }\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result;\n    std::string value = \"SomeValue\";\n    result = value;\n    ASSERT_TRUE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", result.value());\n\n    value = \"SomeOtherValue\";\n    result = value;\n    ASSERT_TRUE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeOtherValue\", result.value());\n  }\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, CopyConstructFromCompatibleTypes) {\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;const char*&gt; from(\"SomeValue\");\n    StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; to(from);\n    ASSERT_TRUE(to.ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", to.value());\n  }\n  {\n    {\n      StatusOr&lt;int&gt; from(0);\n      ASSERT_EQ(0, from.value());\n      StatusOr&lt;bool&gt; to(from);\n      ASSERT_TRUE(to.ok());\n      ASSERT_FALSE(to.value());\n    }\n    {\n      StatusOr&lt;int&gt; from(123);\n      StatusOr&lt;bool&gt; to(from);\n      ASSERT_TRUE(to.ok());\n      ASSERT_TRUE(to.value());\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, CopyAssignFromCompatibleTypes) {\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;const char*&gt; from(\"SomeValue\");\n    StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; to;\n    to = from;\n    ASSERT_TRUE(to.ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", to.value());\n  }\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;int&gt; from(123);\n    StatusOr&lt;bool&gt; to(false);\n    ASSERT_TRUE(to.ok());\n    ASSERT_FALSE(to.value());\n    to = from;\n    ASSERT_TRUE(to.ok());\n    ASSERT_TRUE(to.value());\n  }\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, MoveConstructFromCompatibleTypes) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::unique_ptr&lt;std::string&gt;&gt; from(std::make_unique&lt;std::string&gt;(\"SomeValue\"));\n  ASSERT_TRUE(from.ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", *from.value());\n\n  StatusOr&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;std::string&gt;&gt; to(std::move(from));\n  ASSERT_FALSE(from.ok());\n  ASSERT_TRUE(to.ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", *to.value());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, MoveAssignFromCompatibleTypes)",

copyState(const char *state);\n\n  static std::string format(const char *fmt, va_list args);\n\n  static const char *toString(Code code);\n\n private:\n  struct Header {\n    uint16_t size_;\n    Code code_;\n  };\n  static constexpr auto kHeaderSize = sizeof(Header);\n  // state_ == nullptr indicates OK\n  // otherwise, the buffer layout is:\n  //  state_[0..1] length of the error msg, i.e. size() - kHeaderSize\n  //  state_[2..3] code\n  //  state_[4...] verbose error message\n  std::unique_ptr&lt;const char[]&gt; state_;\n};\n\ninline std::ostream &amp;operator&lt;&lt;(std::ostream &amp;os, const Status &amp;status) {\n  return os &lt;&lt; status.toString();\n}\n\n}  // namespace nebula\n\n#define NG_RETURN_IF_ERROR(s)             \\\n  ",

        "contents": "  ASSERT_FALSE(result2.ok());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, MoveAssignFromStatus) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result1(Status::Error(\"SomeError\"));\n  decltype(result1) result2;\n  result2 = std::move(result1);\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result1.ok());\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result2.ok());\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result2.status().ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeError\", result2.status().toString());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, MoveAssignFromValue) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result1(\"SomeValue\");\n  decltype(result1) result2;\n  result2 = std::move(result1);\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result1.ok());\n  ASSERT_TRUE(result2.ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", result2.value());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, AssignFromStatus) {\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result;\n    result = Status::OK();\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_TRUE(result.status().ok());\n\n    result = Status::Error(\"SomeError\");\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.status().ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeError\", result.status().toString());\n  }\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result;\n    Status status = Status::OK();\n    result = status;\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_TRUE(result.status().ok());\n\n    status = Status::Error(\"SomeError\");\n    result = status;\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.status().ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeError\", result.status().toString());\n  }\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result;\n    Status status = Status::OK();\n    result = std::move(status);\n    ASSERT_TRUE(status.ok());\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_TRUE(result.status().ok());\n\n    status = Status::Error(\"SomeError\");\n    result = std::move(status);\n    ASSERT_TRUE(status.ok());\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result.status().ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeError\", result.status().toString());\n  }\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, AssignFromValue) {\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result;",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2018 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\nnamespace cpp nebula.raftex\n\ninclude \"common.thrift\"\n\nenum Role {\n    LEADER      = 1, // the leader\n    FOLLOWER    = 2; // following a leader\n    CANDIDATE   = 3; // Has sent AskForVote request\n    LEARNER     = 4; // same with FOLLOWER, except that it does\n                     // not vote in leader election\n} (cpp.enum_strict)\n\nenum Status {\n    STARTING            = 0; // The part is starting, not ready for service\n    RUNNING             = 1; // The part is running\n    STOPPED             = 2; // The part has been stopped\n    WAITING_SNAPSHOT    = 3; // Waiting for the snapshot.\n} (cpp.enum_strict)\n\n\ntypedef i64 (cpp.type = \"nebula::ClusterID\") ClusterID\ntypedef i32 (cpp.type = \"nebula::GraphSpaceID\") GraphSpaceID\ntypedef i32 (cpp.type = \"nebula::PartitionID\") PartitionID\ntypedef i64 (cpp.type = \"nebula::TermID\") TermID\ntypedef i64 (cpp.type = \"nebula::LogID\") LogID\ntypedef i32 (cpp.type = \"nebula::Port\") Port\n\n\n// A request to ask for vote\nstruct AskForVoteRequest {\n    1: GraphSpaceID space;              // The graph space id\n    2: PartitionID  part;               // The data partition\n    3: string       candidate_addr;     // My Address\n    4: Port         candidate_port;     // My port\n    5: TermID       term;               // Proposed term\n    6: LogID        last_log_id;        // The last received log id\n    7: TermID       last_log_term;      // The term receiving the last log\n    8: bool         is_pre_vote;        // Is pre vote or not\n}\n\n\n// Response message for the vote call\nstruct AskForVoteResponse {\n    1: common.ErrorCode error_code;\n    2: TermID           current_term;\n}\n\n// Log entries being sent to follower, logId is not included, it could be calculated by\n// last_log_id_sent and offset in log_str_list in AppendLogRequest\nstruct RaftLogEntry {\n    1: ClusterID cluster;\n    2: binary    log_str;",

        "contents": "#define STATUS_GENERATOR(ERROR)                                                     \\\n  static Status ERROR() {                                                           \\\n    return Status(k##ERROR, \"\");                                                                   \\\n    return Status(k##ERROR, msg);                                                   \\\n  }                                                                                 \\\n                                                                                    \\\n  bool is##ERROR() const {                                                          \\\n    return code() == k##ERROR;         "contents": "struct AlterSpaceReq {\n    1: binary           space_name,\n    2: AlterSpaceOp     op,\n    3: list&lt;binary&gt;     paras,\n}\n\n// Job related data structures\nenum JobOp {\n    ADD         = 0x01,\n    SHOW_All    = 0x02,\n    SHOW        = 0x03,\n    STOP        = 0x04,\n    RECOVER     = 0x05,\n} (cpp.enum_strict)\n\nenum JobType {\n    COMPACT                  = 0,\n    FLUSH                    = 1,\n    REBUILD_TAG_INDEX        = 2,\n    REBUILD_EDGE_INDEX       = 3,\n    REBUILD_FULLTEXT_INDEX   = 4,\n    STATS                    = 5,\n    DATA_BALANCE             = 6,\n    DOWNLOAD                 = 7,\n    INGEST                   = 8,\n    LEADER_BALANCE           = 9,\n    ZONE_BALANCE             = 10,\n    UNKNOWN                  = 99,\n} (cpp.enum_strict)\n\nstruct AdminJobReq {\n    1: common.GraphSpaceID  space_id,\n    2: JobOp                op,\n    3: JobType              type,\n    4: list&lt;binary&gt;         paras,\n}\n\nenum JobStatus {\n    QUEUE           = 0x01,\n    RUNNING         = 0x02,\n    FINISHED        = 0x03,\n    FAILED          = 0x04,\n    STOPPED         = 0x05,\n    INVALID         = 0xFF,\n} (cpp.enum_strict)\n\nstruct JobDesc {\n    1: common.GraphSpaceID  space_id,\n    2: i32                  job_id,\n    3: JobType              type,\n    4: list&lt;string&gt;         paras,\n    5: JobStatus            status,\n    6: i64                  start_time,\n    7: i64                  stop_time,\n    8: common.ErrorCode     code,\n}\n\nstruct TaskDesc {\n    1: common.GraphSpaceID  space_id,\n    2: i32                  job_id,\n    3: i32                  task_id,\n    4: common.HostAddr      host,\n    5: JobStatus            status,\n    6: i64                  start_time,\n    7: i64                  stop_time,\n    8: common.ErrorCode     code,\n}\n\nstruct AdminJobResult {\n    // used in a new added job, e.g. \"flush\" \"compact\"",

        "contents": "TEST(StatusOr, MoveAssignFromCompatibleTypes) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::unique_ptr&lt;std::string&gt;&gt; from(std::make_unique&lt;std::string&gt;(\"SomeValue\"));\n  ASSERT_TRUE(from.ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", *from.value());\n\n  StatusOr&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;std::string&gt;&gt; to(std::make_shared&lt;std::string&gt;(\"SomeOtherValue\"));\n  ASSERT_TRUE(to.ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeOtherValue\", *to.value());\n\n  to = std::move(from);\n  ASSERT_FALSE(from.ok());\n  ASSERT_TRUE(to.ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", *to.value());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, MoveOnlyValue) {\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;std::unique_ptr&lt;std::string&gt;&gt; result1(std::make_unique&lt;std::string&gt;(\"SomeValue\"));\n    auto result2 = std::move(result1);\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result1.ok());\n    ASSERT_TRUE(result2.ok());\n    auto ptr = std::move(result2).value();\n    ASSERT_NE(nullptr, ptr.get());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", *ptr);\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result2.ok());\n  }\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;std::unique_ptr&lt;std::string&gt;&gt; result1(std::make_unique&lt;std::string&gt;(\"SomeValue\"));\n    decltype(result1) result2;\n    result2 = std::move(result1);\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result1.ok());\n    ASSERT_TRUE(result2.ok());\n    auto ptr = std::move(result2).value();\n    ASSERT_NE(nullptr, ptr.get());\n    ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", *ptr);\n    ASSERT_FALSE(result2.ok());\n  }\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, MoveOutStatus) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result(Status::Error(\"SomeError\"));\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result.status().ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(Status::Error(\"SomeError\"), result.status());\n  auto status = std::move(result).status();\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result.ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(Status::Error(\"SomeError\"), status);\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, Destruct) {\n  auto ptr = std::make_shared&lt;std::string&gt;(\"SomeValue\");\n  ASSERT_EQ(1UL, ptr.use_count());\n  {\n    StatusOr&lt;std::shared_ptr&lt;std::string&gt;&gt; result;\n    result = ptr;\n    ASSERT_TRUE(result.ok());\n    ASSERT_EQ(2UL, ptr.use_count());\n    auto ptr2 = result.value();\n    ASSERT_EQ(3UL, ptr.use_count());\n  }\n  ASSERT_EQ(1UL, ptr.use_count());\n}\n\n/*\nTEST(StatusOr, ConstructibleButNotConvertible) {\n    struct ConstructibleButNotConvertible {\n        explicit ConstructibleButNotConvertible(double) {}\n    };\n    StatusOr&lt;ConstructibleButNotConvertible&gt; x(1.);\n}\n\n\nTEST(StatusOr, ConvertibleButNotConstructible) {\n    struct ConvertibleButNotConstructible {\n        explicit ConvertibleButNotConstructible(double) = delete;\n        ConvertibleButNotConstructible(int) {}\n    };\n    StatusOr&lt;ConvertibleButNotConstructible&gt; x(1.);\n}\n*/",

        "contents": "TEST(StatusOr, CopyConstructFromValue) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result1(\"SomeValue\");\n  auto result2 = result1;\n  ASSERT_TRUE(result1.ok());\n  ASSERT_TRUE(result2.ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", result1.value());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", result2.value());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, CopyAssignFromDefault) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result1;\n  decltype(result1) result2;\n  result2 = result1;\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result2.ok());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, CopyAssignFromStatus) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result1(Status::Error(\"SomeError\"));\n  decltype(result1) result2;\n  result2 = result1;\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result1.ok());\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result1.status().ok());\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result2.ok());\n  ASSERT_FALSE(result2.status().ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeError\", result1.status().toString());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeError\", result2.status().toString());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, CopyAssignFromValue) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt; result1(\"SomeValue\");\n  decltype(result1) result2;\n  result2 = result1;\n  ASSERT_TRUE(result1.ok());\n  ASSERT_TRUE(result2.ok());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", result1.value());\n  ASSERT_EQ(\"SomeValue\", result2.value());\n}\n\nTEST(StatusOr, MoveConstructFromDefault) {\n  StatusOr&lt;std::string&gt;         "contents": "template &lt;typename LEFT, typename RIGHT&gt;\nclass EitherOr {\n private:\n  // Make friends with other compatible EitherOr&lt;U, V&gt;\n  template &lt;typename U, typename V&gt;\n  friend class EitherOr;\n\n  static_assert(!std::is_same&lt;LEFT, RIGHT&gt;::value,\n                \"The left type and right type of EitherOr&lt;&gt; cannot be same\");\n\n  template &lt;class... Args&gt;\n  struct TypeConverter {\n    TypeConverter() = delete;\n\n    template &lt;class... Types&gt;\n    static constexpr typename std::enable_if_t&lt;std::is_constructible&lt;LEFT, Types...&gt;::value &amp;&amp;\n                                                   !std::is_constructible&lt;RIGHT, Types...&gt;::value,\n                                               LeftType&gt;*\n    sfinae() {\n      return kConstructLeft;\n    }\n\n    template &lt;class... Types&gt;\n    static constexpr typename std::enable_if_t&lt;!std::is_constructible&lt;LEFT, Types...&gt;::value &amp;&amp;\n                                                   std::is_constructible&lt;RIGHT, Types...&gt;::value,\n                                               RightType&gt;*\n    sfinae() {\n      return kConstructRight;\n    }\n\n    template &lt;class... Types&gt;\n    static constexpr typename std::enable_if_t&lt;std::is_constructible&lt;LEFT, Types...&gt;::value &amp;&amp;\n                                               std::is_constructible&lt;RIGHT, Types...&gt;::value&gt;*\n    sfinae() {\n      static_assert(std::is_constructible&lt;LEFT, Types...&gt;::value &amp;&amp;\n                        std::is_constructible&lt;RIGHT, Types...&gt;::value,\n                    \"The arguments can be converted into either\"\n                    \" LEFT or RIGHT, so please use the constructor\"\n                    \" with an explicit tag\");\n    }\n\n    static constexpr State getState() {\n      auto* ptr = sfinae&lt;Args...&gt;();\n      if (std::is_same&lt;decltype(ptr), LeftType*&gt;::value) {\n        return State::LEFT_TYPE;\n      }\n      if (std::is_same&lt;decltype(ptr), RightType*&gt;::value) {\n        return State::RIGHT_TYPE;\n      }\n      return State::VOID;\n    }\n\n    static constexpr auto* type = sfinae&lt;Args...&gt;();\n    static constexpr State state = getState();\n  };",

All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#include \"common/base/Status.h\"\n\n#include \"common/base/Base.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\n\nStatus::Status(Code code, folly::StringPiece msg) {\n  const uint16_t size = msg.size();\n  auto state = std::unique_ptr&lt;char[]&gt;(new char[size + kHeaderSize]);\n  auto *header = reinterpret_cast&lt;Header *&gt;(state.get());\n  header-&gt;size_ = size;\n  header-&gt;code_ = code;\n  ::memcpy(&amp;state[kHeaderSize], msg.data(), size);\n  state_ = std::move(state);\n}\n\nstd::string Status::message() const {\n  if (state_ == nullptr) return \"\";\n  return std::string(&amp;state_[kHeaderSize], size());\n}\n\nstd::string Status::toString() const {\n  Code code = this-&gt;code();\n  if (code == kOk) {\n    return \"OK\";\n  }\n  std::string result(toString(code));\n  result.append(&amp;state_[kHeaderSize], size());\n  return result;\n}\n\nstd::unique_ptr&lt;const char[]&gt; Status::copyState(const char *state) {\n  const auto size = *reinterpret_cast&lt;const uint16_t *&gt;(state);\n  const auto total = size + kHeaderSize;\n  auto result = std::unique_ptr&lt;char[]&gt;(new char[total]);\n  ::memcpy(&amp;result[0], state, total);\n  return result;\n}\n\nstd::string Status::format(const char *fmt, va_list args) {\n  char result[256];\n  vsnprintf(result, sizeof(result), fmt, args);\n  return result;\n}\n\n// static\nconst char *Status::toString(Code code) {\n  switch (code) {\n    case kOk:\n      return \"OK\";",

        "contents": "static bool ValidateFailedLoginAttempts(const char* flagname, uint32_t value) {\n  if (value &lt;= 32767)  // value is ok\n    return true;\n\n  FLOG_WARN(\"Invalid value for --%s: %d, the timeout should be an integer between 0 and 32767\\n\",\n            flagname,\n            (int)value);\n  return false;\n}\nDEFINE_validator(failed_login_attempts, &amp;ValidateFailedLoginAttempts);\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace meta {\n\nIndexes buildIndexes(std::vector&lt;cpp2::IndexItem&gt; indexItemVec);\n\nMetaClient::MetaClient(std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt; ioThreadPool,\n                       std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt; addrs,\n                       const MetaClientOptions&amp; options)\n    : ioThreadPool_(ioThreadPool),\n      addrs_(std::move(addrs)),\n      options_(options),\n      metadata_(new MetaData()) {\n  CHECK(ioThreadPool_ != nullptr) &lt;&lt; \"IOThreadPool is required\";\n  CHECK(!addrs_.empty())\n      &lt;&lt; \"No meta server address is specified or can be solved. Meta server is required\";\n  clientsMan_ = std::make_shared&lt;thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;cpp2::MetaServiceAsyncClient&gt;&gt;(\n      FLAGS_enable_ssl || FLAGS_enable_meta_ssl);\n  updateActive();\n  updateLeader();\n  bgThread_ = std::make_unique&lt;thread::GenericWorker&gt;();\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Create meta client to \" &lt;&lt; active_;\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; folly::sformat(\n      \"root path: {}, data path size: {}\", options_.rootPath_, options_.dataPaths_.size());\n}\n\nMetaClient::~MetaClient() {\n  notifyStop();\n  stop();\n  delete metadata_.load();\n  VLOG(3) &lt;&lt; \"~MetaClient\";\n}\n\n#ifdef BUILD_STANDALONE\nStatusOr&lt;bool&gt; MetaClient::checkLocalMachineRegistered() {\n  auto ret = heartbeat().get();\n  if (!ret.ok()) {\n    if (ret.status().toString() == \"Machine not existed!\") {\n      return false;\n    }\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Check register failed: \" &lt;&lt; ret.status();\n    return Status::Error(\"Check register failed!\");\n  }\n  return true;\n}\n#endif\n\nbool MetaClient::isMetadReady()",

If src is not the leader, return succeed\n   *            2.         "contents": "HostAddr decodeTransferLeader(const folly::StringPiece&amp; log) {\n  auto raw = log;\n  raw.advance(1);\n  return deserializeHostAddr(raw);\n}\n\nstd::string encodeSnapshotRow(LogID logId, const std::string&amp; row) {\n  std::string rawData;\n  rawData.reserve(sizeof(LogID) + row.size());\n  rawData.append(reinterpret_cast&lt;const char*&gt;(&amp;logId), sizeof(logId));\n  rawData.append(row.data(), row.size());\n  return rawData;\n}\n\nstd::pair&lt;LogID, std::string&gt; decodeSnapshotRow(const std::string&amp; rawData) {\n  LogID id = *reinterpret_cast&lt;const LogID*&gt;(rawData.data());\n  auto str = rawData.substr(sizeof(LogID));\n  return std::make_pair(id, std::move(str));\n}\n\nstd::string encodeAddPeer(const HostAddr&amp; addr) {\n  std::string str;\n  CommandType type = CommandType::ADD_PEER;\n  str.append(reinterpret_cast&lt;const char*&gt;(&amp;type), 1);\n  str.append(serializeHostAddr(addr));\n  return str;\n}\n\nHostAddr decodeAddPeer(const folly::StringPiece&amp; log) {\n  auto rawlog = log;\n  rawlog.advance(1);\n  return deserializeHostAddr(rawlog);\n}\n\nstd::string encodeRemovePeer(const HostAddr&amp; addr) {\n  std::string str;\n  CommandType type = CommandType::REMOVE_PEER;\n  str.append(reinterpret_cast&lt;const char*&gt;(&amp;type), 1);\n  str.append(serializeHostAddr(addr));\n  return str;\n}\n\nHostAddr decodeRemovePeer(const folly::StringPiece&amp; log) {\n  auto rawlog = log;\n  rawlog.advance(1);\n  return deserializeHostAddr(rawlog);\n}\n\nstd::shared_ptr&lt;thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;&gt; getClientMan() {\n  static std::shared_ptr&lt;thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;&gt; clientMan(\n      new thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;(FLAGS_enable_ssl));\n  return clientMan;\n}\n\nTestShard::TestShard(size_t idx,\n                     std::shared_ptr&lt;RaftexService&gt; svc",

**修复方案：**
创建了完整的 `SnapshotManager.h` 文件，包含：
1. `SnapshotStatus` 枚举（`IN_PROGRESS`、`DONE`、`FAILED`）
2. `SnapshotCallback` 类型别名（函数类型）
3. `SnapshotManager` 类定义，包括：
   - 构造函数
   - `sendSnapshot` 方法
   - `send` 方法（protected）
   - 纯虚方法 `accessAllRowsInSnapshot`
   - 成员变量：`executor_`、`ioThreadPool_`、`connManager_`

**修复的文件：**
- `/usr/local/nebula/src/kvstore/raftex/SnapshotManager.h` - 创建了完整的类定义

现在 `NebulaSnapshotManager` 可以正确继承 `raftex::SnapshotManager`，编译错误已解决。

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Now I fully understand. Let me explain this to the user.</details></think>

---

这里的 `isListener()` **不是监听 MetaD 或端口**，而是指 Nebula 的一种特殊节点角色——**Listener（监听器）**。

## 解释

### 什么是 Listener？

从 `Listener.h` 的注释可以看到：

```24:34:src/kvstore/listener/Listener.h
/**
 * Listener is a special RaftPart, it will join the raft group as learner. The key difference
 * between learner (e.g. in balance data) and listener is that, listener won't be able to be
 * promoted to follower or leader.
 *
 * Once it joins raft group, it can receive logs from leader and do whatever you like.
```

**Listener 是一种特殊的 Raft 节点**，以 **Learner（学习者）** 身份加入 Raft 组：
- 只接收 Leader 的日志，不参与投票选举
- 不能被提升为 Follower 或 Leader
- 用于将数据同步到外部系统

### 判断依据

```176:178:src/kvstore/NebulaStore.h
  bool isListener() const {
    return !options_.listenerPath_.empty();
  }
```

通过检查 `listenerPath_` 是否为空来判断——这是启动时的配置项，不是动态监听端口。

### 目前支持的 Listener 类型

主要是 **ESListener（Elasticsearch Listener）**：
- 将 Nebula 的数据变更同步到 Elasticsearch
- 用于全文索引功能

### 为什么要区分？

```cpp
if (!isListener()) {
    // 普通 Storage 节点：加载分区数据 + 远程 Listener 信息
    loadPartFromDataPath();
    loadPartFromPartManager();
    loadRemoteListenerFromPartManager();  // 把 Listener 加入 Raft 组
} else {
    // Listener 节点：只加载本地 Listener 配置
    loadLocalListenerFromPartManager();
}
```

| 节点类型 | 数据存储 | Raft 角色 | 加载逻辑 |
|---------|---------|----------|---------|
| 普通 Storage | 有完整数据 | Leader/Follower | 加载分区数据，并把远程 Listener 加入 Raft 组 |
| Listener | 只有 WAL | Learner（永久） | 只加载自己需要监听的分区信息 |

**总结**：这里的"监听"不是网络端口监听，而是**数据同步监听**——Listener 节点监听 Raft 日志变更，同步到外部系统（如 ES）。

---
